metadata.description: MCP tool call throughput thresholds with 20% regression tolerance

baseline.description: Baseline measurements from actual tool handler execution (MCP overhead without device I/O)
baseline.note: Measures tool registry lookup, schema validation, device resolution, and handler wrapper overhead. Updated after ViewHierarchy caching removal (commit 724ae74d). listDevices (#11332) is measured against fakes with a daemon-shaped DevicePool (see scripts/benchmark-listdevices-fixture.ts): local max over 5 runs of 50 samples p50 0.096 / p95 0.314 / mean 0.133 ms, thresholds = 3x that rounded up to 0.1 ms for slower CI runners (the 20% tolerance applies on top).
